elimination.waterfront_harbour_moon: No vegetable dumplings at all (misses Mina)
elimination.waterfront_east_jetty: Milk dough buns, butter pastry, evaporated-milk pudding, milky tea (misses Roxy's dairy intolerance)
elimination.waterfront_lighthouse_row: Windowless cellar, no outdoor seating (misses Liam)
elimination.waterfront_capstan: Quiet, murmuring tea garden (misses Brooke's bustle)
elimination.waterfront_heron_wharf: Fried dim sum (misses Brooke's steamed and light)
elimination.waterfront_sampan: Meets everything: open-air pontoon, loud trolley calling, steamed and light, full meatless trolley, no milk anywhere, $$

notes: Clean one-decoy-per-constraint design: every alternative fails exactly one constraint, so the answer comes out cleanly once all seven constraints are found.
Budget clue (middle shelf, top shelf for yachts) is a nice indirect clue but readable.
Roxy's dairy line is phrased as a 'peace treaty' with her stomach, which makes it clearly an intolerance rather than an allergy. Good.

Small hedge: Sampan's meatless trolley is described as 'on our visit not one basket on it held meat or seafood', which a cautious player might read as not guaranteed. Still the only venue left after elimination, so it does not hurt fairness.
Lighthouse Row's review leads with the windowless cellar, so the outdoor decoy is easy to spot. Capstan's hush and Heron Wharf's frying are also stated plainly. Nothing contradictory found.
